ModMetaData.name: NanoHive Reforged
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
A wall-mounted nanite port that repairs your buildings, items and colonists' gear in range while it has power.
NanoHive Reforged 2: every hive has its own buttons (what to repair, radius, repair rate, buildings first, only stored items), a capped repair budget that fixes the most damaged things first, 200 W idle power, a ring that shows the real radius, an inspect pane, a repair shimmer, and soft Multiplayer support. Chinese Simplified and Russian are included.
No Harmony needed. RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7, both on 2.x from the same source. Saves from 1.x keep working, and safe to add mid-save.
A faithful-plus rebuild of the Nanohive2 mod for RimWorld. All credit for the original idea goes to Nanohive2's author.
Full notes: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/nanohive-reforged
